[[Category:Transformer]]
The '''feed-forward network (FFN) sub-layer''' is the 2nd of the 2 sub-layers of a [[Transformer]] block: a 2-layer [[feedforward algorithm|feedforward network]] applied to each position of the sequence separately, after [[self-attention]].<ref>{{#cite:Q3130}}</ref>

== Definition ==

Let $\mathbf{X}\in\mathbb{R}^{T\times d}$, and let $\mathbf{W}_1\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times d_{ff}}$, $\vec b_1\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{ff}}$, $\mathbf{W}_2\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{ff}\times d}$, $\vec b_2\in\mathbb{R}^{d}$. The sub-layer is

$$
\operatorname{FFN}(\mathbf{X})
=f\left(\mathbf{X}\mathbf{W}_1+\mathbf{1}\vec b_1^{\top}\right)\mathbf{W}_2+\mathbf{1}\vec b_2^{\top},
$$

where $\mathbf{1}\in\mathbb{R}^{T}$ is a column vector of $1$s, so $\mathbf{1}\vec b_1^{\top}$ forms a $T \times d_{ff}$ matrix with the bias vector repeating over every row, and $f$ is an [[activation function]].

<ref>{{#cite:Q3130}}</ref>

== Properties ==

=== Row-wise operation ===

Unlike [[self-attention]], $\operatorname{FFN}$ is row-wise: row $t$ of the output depends on row $t$ of the input alone.

=== Compute ===

The compute for each row of $\mathbf{X}$ is dominated by $d\,d_{ff}$ multiplications with $\mathbf{W}_1$ and $d_{ff}\,d$ multiplications with $\mathbf{W}_2$ (since multiplications dominate over addition), hence

$$
\operatorname{FFN} \in O\left(T\,d\,d_{ff}\right)
$$

where $O(x)$ is the [[o(x) and o(x)|big O notation]].
